description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between answer popularity and values representing accuracy and confidence. The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. 

A blue line, representing “Accuracy”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at a value of approximately 0.52 at an answer popularity of 0, increases to approximately 0.83 at an answer popularity of 40, fluctuates between approximately 0.81 and 0.86 from an answer popularity of 40 to 160, and ends at approximately 0.84 at an answer popularity of 160. 

A green line, representing “Confidence”, is plotted with triangular markers and a solid line style. It begins at a value of approximately 0.92 at an answer popularity of 0, increases to approximately 0.98 at an answer popularity of 40, and remains at approximately 0.99 from an answer popularity of 40 to 160, ending at approximately 0.99 at an answer popularity of 160. 

A red line, representing a third value, is plotted with triangular markers and a dashed line style. It begins at a value of approximately 0.58 at an answer popularity of 0, increases to approximately 0.84 at an answer popularity of 40, declines to approximately 0.81 at an answer popularity of 80, and ends at approximately 0.86 at an answer popularity of 160.
